messages:
Sasha (People Ops): Hey @Alex T. — quick check: can you do a 20-min virtual I-9 verification tomorrow between 9:00–11:00am PT? We'll need either passport OR driver's license + SSN card. Prefer Zoom video.
Alex T.: Morning Sasha — 9:30am PT works for me. I only have DL + SSN card, that's fine right? Also I haven't seen the background check email from Checkr yet.
Sasha (People Ops): DL + SSN card is perfect. I just re-sent the Checkr invite to alex.t@redwood.com — check spam as well. If it still doesn't show up, reply here and I'll trigger a manual resend.
onboarding-bot: Action required: Checkr background check invite sent to alex.t@redwood.com — link expires in 7 days. Track here: https://hr.redwood.com/checkr/status/xxxxxx
Alex T.: Got the Checkr email now, thanks. One other Q: what's the day‑1 orientation schedule? I saw something in the welcome packet but want the live call times.
Sasha (People Ops): Day-1 agenda (live calls):
```
09:00–09:30 PT Welcome + exec intro (Zoom A)
09:45–10:30 PT IT setup & MFA (Zoom B, Ben)
10:45–11:30 PT Benefits overview (Zoom C)
13:00–14:00 PT Team welcome + product tour (Zoom D)
```
Please join Zoom A for the first one, recordings will be uploaded.
Ben (IT): FYI laptop shipped overnight — tracking #1Z999AA10123456784. ETA delivery tomorrow 10am–4pm local. If it doesn't arrive, ping me and I'll authorize a temporary cloud dev VM.
Alex T.: Sweet, tracking shows out for delivery. For the I-9, do I need to upload photos of the docs before the Zoom or present them on camera?
Sasha (People Ops): Present on camera during the live I-9 verification. We do not accept pre-uploaded photos for Section 2. We'll record confirmation that we saw original docs. If you absolutely can't show them on camera, we can do an in-person verification at a regional office — let me know.
Alex T.: Perfect. One last thing — is there a form for direct deposit? I couldn't find it in the welcome packet.
Sasha (People Ops): Direct deposit setup is in the payroll portal. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/payroll/setup — use the "New Hire" tab. If you'd rather, you can fill the PDF and upload it after the benefits call.
Alex T.: Thanks all! See you at 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
Ben (IT): Ping me on Slack if the laptop doesn't boot or you don't get the MFA prompt — happy to remote in.
Sasha (People Ops): Great — closing the loop. I've scheduled the 9:30 PT I-9 slot and will add Zoom details to your calendar. See you tomorrow! :wave:
